verdict.rationale: Stripe's testing docs say the Terminal SDKs and the server-driven integration include a built-in simulated card reader, so developers can build and test without physical hardware. They also explicitly recommend testing with the reader simulator before ordering a reader. This covers the core of the story: end-to-end testing before going live. Missing for 10: details on test card numbers and simulated outcome scenarios (declines, errors), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the simulator.
